newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Anaconda raises A$24 mln from issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Anaconda raises A$24 mln from issue.

text.p: Nickel hopeful Anaconda Nickel NL said on Monday it had issued 7.2 million shares to Swiss commodity trading house Glencore International AG at A$3.38 per share to raise A$24.336 million for the development its Murrin Murrin nickel-cobalt project in Western Australia.
"The issue comprises the exercise of 2.760 million unquoted vendor options and a placement of 4.440 million Anaconda Nickel NL shares," Anaconda said.
"The proceeds of A$24.336 million will be used as working capital to faciliate the development of the Murrin Murrin Nickel Cobalt project," it said.
The issue increases Glencore's stake in Anaconda to 19.99 percent from 14.53 percent.
"The board of Anaconda Nickel welcomes the increase in Glencore's holding in the company," it said.
The A$780 million Murrin Murrin nickel project is forecast to produce 100 million pounds of nickel a year once it is fully operational in mid-1998.
Anaconda said in its annual report released last week that it expected to be in a position to select a Murrin Murrin joint venture partner in the current quarter.
"Preparation of draft agreements has commenced with potential joint venturers which are two major mining companies and Swiss-based commodities trader Glencore AG," Anaconda said.

It also said then that an Asian industrial conglomerate had pursued detailed negotiations with Anaconda with a view to purchasing a 30 percent direct interest in the project and provide distribution facilities to the Asian markets.
The company also said then one of the "world's largest banks" had also approached Anaconda with an offer to provide US$500 million in a project-linked finance facility.
